When you have trouble even getting a job, working your ass off, sacrificing your peace and happiness, and STILL not being able to find success. that is a real FAILURE of society.

I don't understand why we ever left the times of fathers teaching their sons, and mothers their daughters. Boys used to work alongside their fathers, learning a marketable skill, be it farming, blacksmithing, pottery making, business dealings, etc. The young men could then go out into the world prepared, at least with something they could feasibly survive off of. Mothers would raise their daughters to become future wives and mothers, a glorious position in life, which has been perverted by the likes of feminism, which has done more damage than any war ever has. If one were to care to look back on the downfall of humanity, that would be a huge bullet point. 

Back to what I was saying though, the young women would then enter into the world prepared to become wives and mothers, able to cook, clean, sew, and otherwise maintain the home and raise the kids. We all know how life is supposed to work: The man is the breadwinner, working hard to fund life, and in appreciation for this sacrifice, his loving wife maintains the home, greets him with a homecooked meal, and does other things that make his sacrifices worth doing. Things worked like this for centuries, millennia even, and all it took was one absolutely evil and misguided concept to ruin it. Now we have women saying they don't need a man, and would rather trust a bear than them, and men are now, for lack of a better term, scared to place their trust in women, to make their hearts vulnerable to attacks like ridicule, rejection, divorce, cheating, child support, false rape claims, the list goes on. There is no reason for a man to risk his good name and assets for someone who may very well ruin and take everything he has. The sexes are as separate as oil and water at this point, and things are going to get very bad if this continues.

As I said, we're witnessing the end, some people just don't realize or accept it yet. We have men who see no reason to participate in a society that doesn't care about them, only sees them as worker drones, and then there's the overly entitled women who ostracize 99% of the men who show interest as unworthy. We will see the likes of population crashes, government incentivization for marriage, possibly programs for something like 'breeding visas', hiring men to produce children with willing women, and if things get bad enough, taxes on single men, and only them, because women are deified in this society.
